entries: Existing narrative outline extended in place: explains the transition from relative gaps to closed examples and from fixed errors to the HMT polynomial method; navigation is not registered as a prerequisite.
One fixed-threshold WP spectral-gap theorem; corrected the Mirzakhani denominator to 2*pi+log(2), retained the eta loss and separated the HMT strengthening as a consequence link.
One bibliographic record for Expose 1255, with distinct source versions and precise supporting-paper locations; no mathematical prerequisite edges.
The HMT one-sided polynomial WP gap, with a local final deduction from explicitly external master/support/positive-gap inputs; no explicit or optimal exponent claimed.
One deterministic random-variable counterexample separating fixed-epsilon convergence from any polynomial rate; not a claimed geometric counterexample.
Constructs one Fourier-positive test function by convolution square and proves the real-axis positivity and imaginary-axis scale needed later.
Defines one bounded diagonal spectral multiplier and decodes the square-root convention below the threshold; trace is a later application.
One diagonal trace summability criterion for h=x*htilde, with basis independence and failure when h(0) is nonzero; curve application separately invokes the trace formula.
Defines compactly supported distributions, their support, and polynomial moments; separates distributions from positive probability measures.
One cited uniform spectral-moment expansion with exact q>t and g>C0*q^C0 quantifiers; the genus-dependent error and first coefficients are explicit.
One cited smooth-statistics master inequality, specifying h=x*htilde, the theta derivative, uniform constants and normalized trace.
Proves the leading functional vanishes by checking the spectral multiplier's image on every integration point.
Proves the exponential convolution moment equals evaluation at b=f(i/2), isolating the constant eigenfunction contribution.
One elementary hyperbolic-function inequality, proved by differentiation; its use in repeated-geodesic summation is a consequence, not a prerequisite.
Bounds the residual coefficient moments by 2*a^(p+1), treating the k=1 cancellation and k>=2 terms explicitly.
Proves the HMT support cancellation with the source's 0.0023 upper cutoff; invokes the separately stated distribution moment criterion.
Constructs a compactly supported smooth cutoff and proves the conservative epsilon^(-m) bound, including division by x and composition with b*cos(theta).
Proves exactly the normalized-trace-to-polynomial-threshold probability step, with c*m<1 and a separately retained prior small-gap failure probability.
Computes the integral of the model edge density; labels the transfer to shrinking random spectral windows and Tracy-Widom limits as heuristic.
Proves the cusp parity and genus k+1 of the handle-glued surface from chi=-2k; makes no spectral claim from topology.
States the external handle lemma with limsup, not liminf or an eventual-for-all-t inequality; distinguishes handle gluing from puncture filling.
Derives closed examples by selecting increasingly large even covering degrees after fixing each error, then choosing a handle parameter; all deep inputs are named.
States the cited HMT closed-cover polynomial relative gap and explains why an old eigenvalue survives; no uniform moduli-space probability claim.
One cited compact Selberg trace identity, retaining HMT's oriented primitive geodesics and 1/(2*sinh) normalization; no cuspidal trace formula imported.
Proves deterministic existence separately for every sufficiently large genus from positive probability, with no claim to reach the exact 1/4 endpoint.
One explicitly cited moment-support theorem for compact distributions; advanced Cauchy-transform input remains external, not hidden in a proof sketch.

proof_boundaries.0O01: Local assembly proof only; HMT moment/master results, distribution support criterion, and Mirzakhani positive gap remain cited inputs.
proof_boundaries.0O05: Diagonal summability and basis independence are local; the hyperbolic-curve application uses Selberg's trace formula.
proof_boundaries.0O0D: Residual moments and scalar evaluation are local; the moment-to-support theorem 0O0N is external.
proof_boundaries.0O0G: The density integral and exponent arithmetic are proved; actual shrinking-window eigenvalue statistics are not.
proof_boundaries.0O0J: Probability selection, parity and genus arithmetic are local; Otal-Rosas, Hide-Magee, the handle lemma, and Huber are external.
proof_boundaries.0O0M: The probabilistic existence deduction is local, conditional on HMT and Huber.

audit_notes: 0GS9 Mirzakhani constant corrected to (1/4)*(log(2)/(2*pi+log(2)))^2 = 0.0024679513226208375, matching Petri p.31 and HMT's positive-gap cutoff.
The old 0GS0 statement calling Brooks-Makover near-optimality open was removed; Petri section 5.1.2 reports subsequent progress. No new proof or model transfer was asserted.

The HMT v2 printed p.26 cutoff bound is epsilon^(-m/2). New notes do not use that claim: they independently prove the weaker epsilon^(-m) estimate sufficient for some positive exponent. Petri p.52's printed epsilon=o(g^(2/m)) closing condition is not used; the correct condition is obtained directly from the displayed probability bound.
0O0L normalization was checked against a rendered image of HMT v2 p.9: Area/(4*pi), oriented primitive geodesics, ell/(2*sinh(k*ell/2)).
All manually edited files are the owned 0O01-0O0N notes, 0GS0, 0GS9, the Petri reference and this manifest. No changes to the existing Monk-Naud reference or global audit records.
